  SDK: alibabacloud_ocr_api
  Interface: sdk

  SDK: google-cloud-documentai
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: process_document
  Setup hints: GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS
  Official docs: https://cloud.google.com/document-ai/docs/overview

Option 4 — Mindee:
  Service: Mindee Document OCR
  SDK: mindee
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: parse, enqueue_and_parse
  Setup hints: MINDEE_API_KEY

  Service: Amazon Textract
  SDK: boto3
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: detect_document_text, analyze_document
  Setup hints: AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID, AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY
  Official docs: https://docs.aws.amazon.com/textract/latest/dg/what-is.html

output_text:
```python
import json
from azure.ai.documentintelligence import DocumentIntelligenceClient
from azure.core.credentials import AzureKeyCredential
from azure.core.pipeline import PipelineBehavior
from azure.core.pipeline.parameters import OperationStatusCodes

# Configuration
AZURE_DOCUMENT_INTELLIGENCE_ENDPOINT = "https://<your-resource-name>.cognitiveservices.azure.com/"
AZURE_DOCUMENT_INTELLIGENCE_KEY = "your-key-here"

# Initialize the Document Intelligence client
credential = AzureKeyCredential(AZURE_DOCUMENT_INTELLIGENCE_KEY)
pipeline = PipelineBehavior(next_retry=credential)
client = DocumentIntelligenceClient(endpoint=AZURE_DOCUMENT_INTELLIGENCE_ENDPOINT, credential=credential, pipeline=pipeline)

# Function to extract tables from a document
def extract_tables_from_document(file_path):
    # Analyze the document
    response = client.begin_analyze_document(file_path=file_path, models=["table-recognition"])

    # Wait for the analysis to complete
    while True:
        result = client.get_analyze_document_result(response.operation_location)
        if result.status_code == OperationStatusCodes.SUCCEEDED:
            break
        elif result.status_code == OperationStatusCodes.FAILED:
            raise Exception(f"Document analysis failed: {result.error}")
        else:
            print(f"Waiting for analysis to complete... Status: {result.status_code}")

    # Extract tables from the analysis result
    tables = result.read_tables()
    return tables

# Example usage
if __name__ == "__main__":
    file_path = "path/to/your/document.pdf"
    tables = extract_tables_from_document(file_path)
    print(json.dumps(tables, indent=2))
```
